revision: Every request identity is JSON [host turn, revision]; default revision 0. Steering requires latest active host turn and exactly next revision.
Steer: Local adapter event with prompt and revision; not asserted to be a native Codex hook. Superseded revisions have no completed episode.
ContextRestore: Local adapter event with compaction_id, revision, request_digest and context_digest; latest active revision only. No lifecycle mutation, summary interpretation or completion.
restoration: Stored allowlisted projection, exact current lifecycle state digest, max 8192 bytes; temporary items apply only to same revision.
duplicates: Rejected without retry effects. Recovery failure never returns stale guidance.
compatibility: Existing prompt, stop and interrupt events default to revision zero. Stop after steering must identify current revision explicitly.
scope: Exact isolated session, workspace, transcript, participant, product and ledger; no subagents.
